subtitle: Cash Is King
sentences: Today, I would like to talk about cash flow management, an essential skill for every future manager.
Cash flow is the movement of money into and out of a business over a specific period.
Surprisingly, a company can be profitable on paper and still run out of cash.
This happens when customers pay late, inventory grows too fast, or expenses come before revenue.
Good managers forecast their cash needs carefully and keep a safety buffer for difficult times.
For example, many fast-growing startups fail not because of weak products, but because they run out of cash.
